evidence.excerpt:
Shipments for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 totaled $854 million, $973 million, and $596 million, respectively. Repeat tool shipments in the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 totaled $466 million,
$505 million, and $310 million, respectively. First tool shipments for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 totaled $388 million, $468 million, and $286 million, respectively.

notes: Non-GAAP operational shipment-value measure, not tool count or revenue. Original p66 defines total/repeat/first and conditional first-tool expected consideration; cumulative cost of unaccepted tools is separately inventory, not this value. Total overlaps its two components. Retain printed whole USD millions; no precision beyond source. FY2023 retained as sibling comparative in same passage, not a historical-depth campaign.
